subject: Ad-hoc procurement routing for NewLeaf pilot — approval criteria?
messages:
From: Mark Taylor <mtaylor@newleaf.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lane <sarah@procurepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for NewLeaf — ad-hoc approval?

Hi Priya / Redwood procurement team,

We're excited to kick off a 6-week pilot with Redwood (NewLeaf Solutions) next week. Legal is moving quickly on the SOW, but our internal procurement system can't issue a PO in time — the vendor portal requires a vendor code and leads time we won't get before the pilot invoice is due.

The invoice is a one-off pilot fee for $7,500 USD. Can Redwood accept an ad-hoc onboarding/one-time approval so we can get billing set up and start the pilot? Happy to provide evidence (insurance cert, W-9) and a signed onboarding form.

Quick ask: what documentation and approvals do you need to make an exception for a single invoice under your PO policy? If helpful, Sarah from ProcurePoint is copied to advise on typical intake.

Attaching: newleaf-invoice-sample.pdf

Thanks,
Mark Taylor
Head of Partnerships
NewLeaf Solutions
mtaylor@newleaf.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Mark Taylor <mtaylor@newleaf.ai>, procurement@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for NewLeaf — ad-hoc approval?

Thanks Mark — welcome and glad we're moving fast.

Procurement, looping you in to evaluate an exception path. Marissa, can you confirm the approvals needed and whether this fits our one-time/ad-hoc criteria?

Mark — to speed things along, I'm attaching our short ad-hoc approval form. For procurement to greenlight a no-PO path we typically need:
- Invoice <= $10,000 (one-time)
- Signed onboarding/statement of work
- Evidence of insurance / liability coverage and tax documents
- Clear billing contact and delivery confirmation email for when work is complete

If procurement approves, we can route invoicing to finance with a one-time acceptance and record the approval in HubSpot. Please complete the attached form and return it to me.

Attaching: ad-hoc-approval-form.pdf

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Ext: 4832

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Mark Taylor <mtaylor@newleaf.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO for NewLeaf — procurement intake

Priya / Mark — thanks for the details. I reviewed the invoice and the proposed pilot fee. Procurement's preliminary assessment below.

Summary: one-time pilot fee $7,500 — low dollar, limited scope. NewLeaf is not yet in our vendor portal.
Risks: vendor not onboarded (no tax withholding), contract terms are standard but we need to confirm insurance and IP clauses in SOW.

Recommended path
- Approvals required: Procurement Manager (Marissa) + Sales Director (Aditya) for one-time exception under $10k
- Conditions: completed ad-hoc approval form, uploaded proof of insurance, completed W-9 or foreign equivalent, invoice matched to signed SOW
- Financial routing: Finance will pay on receipt if the above are met and Procurement records the exception in the compliance log

I've prepared a short criteria matrix and a stub for recording the exception. If Finance gives go, we can approve today and onboard NewLeaf into the vendor portal post-payment.

Attaching: ad-hoc-criteria-matrix.xlsx

@Grace — please confirm budget/owner for the pilot and whether there are any objections from the account team side.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Approval requested: one-time exception for NewLeaf pilot ($7,500)

Aditya — requesting your approval for a one-time procurement exception for NewLeaf. Below is a brief summary (pulled from the thread):

- Amount: $7,500 one-time pilot fee
- Reason: vendor onboarding timing mismatch; need billing to start pilot next week
- Conditions procurement requires: completed ad-hoc approval form (attached), proof of insurance, signed SOW, and invoice matched to SOW
- Recommendation: ProcMgr (Marissa) recommends approval pending Finance confirmation; Sales to own budget

Attached: procurement-summary.docx (one-page decision memo)

Can you confirm sign-off (Aditya Rao) to allow Finance to pay without a PO and for Procurement to record the exception? If approved, procurement will process payment routing and then onboard NewLeaf into vendor portal for future POs.

Thanks — Priya

Approved — I authorize a one-time no-PO payment for NewLeaf up to $7,500 under these strict conditions:
1) Signed onboarding/SOW uploaded to procurement folder
2) Proof of insurance and tax document on file
3) Invoice routed to finance referencing HubSpot deal NL-4582 and procurement exception ID (to be assigned)
4) Procurement to log the exception and update the vendor portal within 5 business days of payment

Priya/Marissa — please confirm when the files are uploaded and Finance has a payment date. Procurement and Finance should maintain the record for audit. I'll follow up to ensure we capture a short post-mortem to inform whether the policy needs a small procedural update for pilot customers.

Thanks,
